title: Learning What the True Labels Would Teach: Posterior Analytic Class-Incremental Learning with Unlabeled Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.20937v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In class-incremental learning with unlabeled data, each task brings only class names and unlabeled images, so CLIP's zero-shot predictions replace labels. Existing methods train on hard pseudo-labels, but a wrong one gives the true class zero probability, which self-training often confirms. We argue that each image should carry its label posterior, as an analytic classifier trained on posteriors equals the true-label one in expectation. The zero-shot prediction is not this posterior, as its class proportions confound name bias with true imbalance and it ignores other images. We propose Posterior Analytic Class-Incremental Learning (PACIL), which corrects the class prior with a prior selection rule and refines each distribution by a fixed-prior von Mises-Fisher mixture on whitened features. translated_title: 学习真实标签所能传授的知识：基于无标注数据的后验解析式类增量学习
translated_abstract: 在无标注数据的类增量学习中，每个任务仅提供类别名称和无标注图像，因此CLIP的零样本预测被用来替代标签。现有方法在硬伪标签上训练，但错误的伪标签会给真实类别赋予零概率，而自训练往往进一步强化这种错误。我们主张每张图像都应携带其标签后验分布，因为以后验分布训练的解析分类器在期望意义上等同于以真实标签训练的分类器。然而零样本预测并非该后验分布，因为其类别比例将名称偏差与真实类别不平衡混为一谈，且忽略了其他图像的信息。我们提出后验解析类增量学习方法，通过先验选择规则校正类别先验，并在白化特征上使用固定先验的von Mises-Fisher混合模型精炼每个分布。这些软标签不仅用于训练分类器，还替代标签，通过闭式留一交叉验证来选择分类器与零样本CLIP的融合权重。
tldr: 该论文提出PACIL方法，为每张无标注图像构建标签后验分布作为软标签，通过先验选择规则校正类别先验并以白化特征上的固定先验von Mises-Fisher混合模型精炼分布，使得基于后验训练的解析分类器在期望意义上等同于真实标签训练的结果。
en_tdlr: PACIL constructs label posteriors as soft labels for unlabeled images by correcting the class prior with a prior selection rule and refining distributions via a fixed-prior von Mises-Fisher mixture on whitened features, so the posterior-trained analytic classifier matches the true-label one in expectation.
